data.name: Dhrish
data.long_meaning: Dhrish means 'determined' or 'radiant'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'dhr' which means 'to hold' or 'to support'. The name signifies one who is strong, determined and has the ability to hold and support. It is also associated with the radiant sun, symbolizing power and strength.

in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dhrish is a variant of the name Dhruv, which means 'pole star' or 'the one that never sets'. In Sanskrit, the name Dhrish is written as धृव:/धृव: and is derived from the word धृति:, which means steadfastness, firmness, consistency. The pole star is a celestial body that always remains in the same position in the night sky, providing a stable reference point for navigators. This name is therefore a fitting choice for a child who is expected to be steadfast and unwavering in his or her pursuits.
